mechanism: Mycophenolate may increase haloperidol levels through inhibition of enterohepatic recirculation and potential CYP3A4 interactions, while both drugs can cause CNS effects and mycophenolate increases infection risk in immunosuppressed patients receiving antipsychotics.
action: Monitor for increased haloperidol side effects (extrapyramidal symptoms, sedation) and consider haloperidol dose reduction if needed; maintain infection surveillance given immunosuppression.
